summary: The notebook currently holds two published notes: a course note on gradient descent and a reading note on the Transformer paper.

areas.label: Machine Learning
areas.coverage: One course note covers gradient descent fundamentals including the update rule, a worked quadratic example, and learning-rate failure modes.
areas.gap: The ml-foundations course has only its first note published; broader foundational topics like linear models and regularization are not yet covered.

areas.label: Deep Learning
areas.coverage: A structured reading note covers the Transformer architecture, scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, and WMT 2014 translation results.
areas.gap: The critique section flags sub-quadratic attention, positional encoding improvements, and training-stability recipes as open directions for future notes.
